title: build_chain takes trust_anchors: &[Certificate] but only uses it for subject DER lookup
description: build_chain() takes trust_anchors: &[Certificate] and iterates it twice: once to build anchor_subjects (subject DERs as HashSet), and once implicitly through the stop condition. The second use is only the pre-computed anchor_subjects set. The anchor_subjects set is built using filter_map with .ok() which silently drops failures. The ownership/borrowing design is fine but the parameter could be typed as an iterator or as a pre-computed set to make the interface clearer. Low priority.
close_reason: build_chain needs &[Certificate] for (1) pre-computing anchor_subjects HashSet and (2) bridging to pkix_chain::TrustAnchor. The slice is used fully. Opinion.
